name: testing_language
source:
## Pull Requests
Before opening a PR, make sure the suite is green. `pytest`

name: security_policy_language
source:
## Security
Never include credentials, API keys, or tokens in code, tests, logs, fixtures, or examples.

name: contributing_pr_workflow
source:
## Contributing
Keep the PR focused and avoid broad rewrites. Report what changed.

source:
# Project
This project is useful.

Development notes: use the shared helpers and update docs when behavior changes. Run `npm test` before merging.

Install with `pip install -e .` and run tests with `pytest`.

source:

Do not edit generated files manually.
